name: Switch of play: far-side overlap while the passer supports the ball

observations.label: passer
evidence: sets off from the kick itself, not after the ball has arrived
runs relative to where the ball is going rather than square to their own position

observations.label: receiver
observations.trigger: offering an angle for the ball already travelling
evidence: opens the body to receive across, not with back to play

observations.label: wideRunner
observations.trigger: unmarked on the opposite flank as the ball switches
evidence: stays in the wide channel rather than cutting inside
no defender within tracking distance when the run begins
the run is on the far side from where the ball currently is

source.note: Authored observation only. Three reusable fragments were recorded from one passage rather than one indivisible sequence.
